author.name: IPERCONTENT S.N.C. DI GIOPP LORENZO E FRANCESCO

description:
IperContent Leads brings a licensed worldwide business catalog, public website evidence and your IperContent lead workspace into your AI conversations. Discover available countries, categories and locations, search businesses with optional contact filters, open business details and inspect selected websites for factual observations and public contact information.

Keep your prospecting in one place: save promising businesses to a lead list, mark the rest not a fit, continue a saved search where you stopped, see which follow-ups are due, draft messages from your own templates and log a contact after you have made it. The same records appear in the IperContent browser workspace, where every change made through ChatGPT is labelled.

Catalog results include source attribution; website observations include evidence links and inspection times. Missing information stays unknown. Coverage is incomplete, and records may be missing or outdated. Website observations do not establish purchase intent, email deliverability or a named decision-maker.

Connect a verified IperContent account through OAuth. New verified accounts receive a one-time free allowance of 25 catalog queries and 10 useful website checks; saving and updating leads uses no allowance. This connector never sends messages: you send them from your own mailbox or phone. It cannot delete leads, lists or templates, export your workspace, make purchases or expose private billing details; those stay on the IperContent website.

defaultPrompt: Find five hotels in Verona and show their available details and sources.
Find hotels in Verona and inspect one public website for evidence I can use to assess relevance.
Show my remaining catalog queries and website checks.
